p.src: 1  Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

en: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
u.src: 1  Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

p.src: 2  But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

en: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
u.src: 2  But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

p.src: 3  But anyone who loves God is known by him.

en: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
u.src: 3  But anyone who loves God is known by him.

p.src: 4  Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

en: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
u.src: 4  Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

p.src: 5  For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

en: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—
u.src: 5  For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

p.src: 6  yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

en: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
u.src: 6  yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

p.src: 7  However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

en: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
u.src: 7  However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

p.src: 8  But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

en: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.
u.src: 8  But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

p.src: 9  But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

en: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
u.src: 9  But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

p.src: 10  For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

en: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
u.src: 10  For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

p.src: 11  And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

en: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
u.src: 11  And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

p.src: 12  Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

en: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
u.src: 12  Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

p.src: 13  Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

en: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
u.src: 13  Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
